title: TensorWave signs 15-year lease at Fermi's Project Matador (~$6.5B)

sources.quote: The lease is expected to generate approximately $6.5 billion in total contracted revenue over the initial 15-year term, for the first phase, excluding any renewal terms.
A binding 15 - year phase one lease for 222 MW of total power capacity, backed by credit support from AMD

explain: AI cloud company TensorWave agreed to lease a 222-megawatt first phase at Fermi's Project Matador campus near Amarillo, Texas, for 15 years, worth about $6.5 billion; AMD provides credit support. Closing was extended to October 31, 2026.
